direction.mobileSafeArea: Keep speakers, faces, paperwork, and story-critical objects inside the centered 60% of the frame.
direction.tone: Grounded industrial mining with warm work lights, dark stone, practical equipment, and restrained corporate branding.
direction.rule: Approve and integrate one scene at a time. Scene 1 is first.

scenes.title: Blackstone Shaft 7 — New Hire
requiredDetails: work lamps and practical safety equipment
scenes.storyBeat: Cole explains ownership, wages, production expectations, and the realities of being replaceable.

scenes.title: Foreman Cole's Office
scenes.location: Blackstone administrative office near the mine
requiredDetails: mine visible beyond office glass or doorway
scenes.storyBeat: The player receives more responsibility and better ground without a meaningful raise.

scenes.title: Senior Miner Underground Heading
scenes.storyBeat: Cole recognizes the player's skill but credits Blackstone's infrastructure for that success.

scenes.title: Shift Lead / Contract Paperwork
scenes.storyBeat: The player discovers the $5,000 contract release clause.

scenes.title: The Walkout
scenes.storyBeat: The player pays for freedom and tells Cole, ‘At least I'll be going broke for myself.’

scenes.title: Freedom Claim Arrival
scenes.storyBeat: The operation is smaller and rougher, but every recovered resource belongs to the player.
